description: Drag a finger in a straight line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2), in screen pixels. Use it for gestures scroll doesn't cover: moving a slider, swiping a card or a message aside, pulling down to refresh, dragging on a map. A very short swipe counts as a tap. Returns "Swiped"; call read_screen to see the result.

duration_ms.description: How long the drag takes, 50 to 3000 ms (default 300); slower is more like dragging, faster like flinging

name: swipe
